dedupe_keys.name: ursec uruguay telecom open data monthly mobile and fixed subscribers traffic and fibre optic kilometres by department

description: Uruguay's communications regulator publishes sector data on the national open data catalogue. Telecom datasets include monthly subscribers to mobile services, split into prepaid and postpaid; monthly subscribers to fixed telecommunications services; traffic of fixed and mobile telecommunications services; commercial fixed telephony; public telephones; and kilometres of optical fibre in the national territory by department. Each dataset is offered as CSV, XLSX and XML with a JSON metadata file, and all were refreshed in February 2026. The fibre dataset is one of few national open series of backbone and access fibre length by region in Latin America. Other URSEC datasets cover postal items, budgets and resolutions. Coverage: Uruguay, national and by department. Format and access: CSV, XLSX and XML on catalogodatos.gub.uy and its CKAN API, free under the Uruguayan public data licence (Licencia de Datos Abiertos del Uruguay). Caveats: the fibre series does not say whether it covers backbone, access or both, nor who owns it; update cadence appears yearly despite monthly figures; the start of the series was not checked. Simulation uses: departmental fibre extent for exposure and redundancy studies, and subscriber and traffic series for Uruguayan demand models. Related records: the LAC-IX survey and map covers Uruguayan exchange points; the TeleGeography submarine cable map covers Uruguay's landings.
